input.diff:
diff --git a/distribution/install.sh b/distribution/install.sh
index 331db681..a33deda1 100755
--- a/distribution/install.sh
+++ b/distribution/install.sh
@@ -151,7 +151,12 @@ fetch_url() { # $1 = URL, $2 = destination
 
 # One release asset over the direct route.
 direct_get() { # $1 = asset name, $2 = destination
-	fetch_url "$download_base/$tag/$1" "$2" || die "$fetch_error"
+	fetch_url "$download_base/$tag/$1" "$2" && return 0
+	asset_error=$fetch_error
+	if fetch_url "https://api.github.com/repos/relatedb/relate/releases/tags/$tag" "$tmp/release-info.json"; then
+		echo "Release $tag exists. Check the asset name: $1" >&2
+	fi
+	die "$asset_error"
 }

content.text:
The patch adds a call to `api.github.com` in `install.sh`. That breaks ADR-0585, which says the installer consults no GitHub API endpoint. The replay confirms it: two of the three checks fail.

{"verdict": "violates", "decisions": ["ADR-0585"], "checks": ["drift guard: install.sh consults no GitHub API endpoint (ADR-0585)", "token set: no Authorization header anywhere (GITHUB_TOKEN never rides a request)", "no case made a GitHub API request (ADR-0585)"], "check_outcomes": {"drift guard: install.sh consults no GitHub API endpoint (ADR-0585)": "fails", "token set: no Authorization header anywhere (GITHUB_TOKEN never rides a request)": "passes", "no case made a GitHub API request (ADR-0585)": "fails"}}
